title: RPLMS v2
summary: A rental and property-management platform with four dashboards, modernized step by step from my earlier Laravel project.
role: Everything: the plan, the security and dependency work, the fixes, the new features, the tests and the deployment guide.
description: RPLMS is a platform for renting and managing properties: listings with search, filters and comparison, wishlists, tour scheduling, service packages for agents, live chat between users and agents, a blog and PDF invoices. It has four areas: the public site, a user dashboard, an agent dashboard and an admin dashboard.

Version 1 was a Laravel 10 project. Version 2 is that same code brought up to date in the open, one small pull request at a time: first the dependencies and the secrets, then the bugs and the security gaps, then the features a modern listing site has. The old folder, its database and its repository stayed untouched as the backup the whole time.

highlights.title: Safety before features
highlights.text: The first items pinned every dependency, removed keys and a database dump from the code, and added git hooks that refuse secrets. Only then did the bug fixes start.

highlights.title: One gate for every change
highlights.text: A single command runs the code style, all tests, the hook tests, the secret scan, the dependency audits and the build. It runs before every push and again on GitHub.

highlights.title: Tests that are proven to test
highlights.text: Each new test is run once without its fix to see it fail, then with the fix to see it pass, and the pull request says so.

highlights.title: Features of a modern listing site
highlights.text: Search on a map, saved searches with a daily e-mail of new matches, a photo carousel and lightbox, agent profiles, a mortgage calculator and a live chat with unread counts and read receipts.
